svg.title: Proof. The path identity Uγ = r−1 x Aγry at a closed path gives the conjugation formula. The chord ∥g−1∥F/√m is invariant under conjugation by a unitary matrix, which gives the second equality at every plaquette and therefore equality of the two flag sets. The preimage formula is a restatement. The frame action sends Ap to kxApk−1 x , which again preserves every chord. Finally π(r, A) is the gauge transform of A by gx = r−1 x , so a gauge-invariant F has F ◦π(r, A) = F(A).
